ratios.covenant_name: maximum consolidated senior net leverage ratio
ratios.quote: The 2024 Credit Facility contains a financial maintenance covenant which only applies while total borrowings exceed $30.0 million, which requires the Company to maintain a maximum consolidated senior net leverage ratio of 3:1.

parsed.notes: The covenant is a springing test that applies only while total borrowings exceed $30.0 million. At September 30, 2026 nothing was drawn other than $4.3 million of letters of credit, so the test was likely not in effect. No actual ratio is disclosed. I classed the senior net leverage ratio as net_leverage; it could also be read as secured net leverage, since the facility is first-lien secured. The leverage-based interest margins and commitment fees were excluded because they only set pricing.
